guard: A race arm's pure work is cut only when the arm can no longer win: the winner is a function of the recorded clocks and declaration order, never of the scheduler or `yieldEvery`. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)
why: The design measured (§3.4) that `yieldEvery` selected the winner of a live race: a loser in a pure
tail was cut at its next yield, so whether an arm with the earlier clock got to settle depended on
how many dispatches its tail took against the pin. The two cells graded here are the two arms of
the repaired rule, one variable apart: the spinner cut because it cannot win the tie (declared
second, equal clock), and the spinner not cut because it could (declared first). A mutation that
cuts always is the old behaviour; a mutation that never cuts is the naive repair that lets a loser
spin the run into its step budget when it had already lost.

mutations.name: every cancelled arm is cut at its next yield (the old behaviour)
mutations.find: (frames[j] as Frame).signal.cancel("a sibling branch won the race", { cutPure: behindFrontier(j) });
mutations.replace: (frames[j] as Frame).signal.cancel("a sibling branch won the race", { cutPure: true });
mutations.expectRed: a spinning arm that could still win is not cut: the step budget ends it (L4013)
mutations.completionMarker: ok and the arm declared first wins the tie
mutations.cell: a spinning arm that could still win is not cut: the step budget ends it (L4013)

mutations.name: no arm is ever cut at a yield (the naive repair)
mutations.find: (frames[j] as Frame).signal.cancel("a sibling branch won the race", { cutPure: behindFrontier(j) });
mutations.replace: (frames[j] as Frame).signal.cancel("a sibling branch won the race", { cutPure: false });
mutations.expectRed: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns
mutations.completionMarker: ok so the timer is measuring the yield, not the runtime
mutations.cell: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns
mutations.note: Reddens as HUNG after the 8 s watchdog, which is the honest signal: the run does not return inside its budget window.

mutations.name: the yield boundary ignores the cut
mutations.expectRed: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns
mutations.completionMarker: ok so the timer is measuring the yield, not the runtime
mutations.cell: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns

mutations.name: the tie falls to the arm declared LATER
mutations.expectRed: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns
mutations.completionMarker: ok so the timer is measuring the yield, not the runtime
mutations.cell: a spinning arm that cannot win is cut at its next yield and the run returns
mutations.note: Declaration order is half of the rule. Reversed, the spinner declared second could still win and is not cut, and the run spins into HUNG.
